dedupe_keys.name: aosta valley landscape plan housing and castle system layers

description: The Autonomous Region of Aosta Valley publishes housing and castle-system layers within its territorial landscape plan (PTP). The three native entries identify dwellings, the PMIR 3 castle system and its symbol representation. Their shared plan, publisher and cartographic lineage establish complementary planning components; the castle symbols do not constitute an additional inventory. The source describes the schema of programmatic guidelines, not a current survey of occupied buildings. Cartography was created on the regional numerical technical map at 1:10,000 in ED50/UTM32N. Native metadata is dated December 2010, which does not establish the observation date of every building or implementation of the plan. GeoJSON is named in the distribution descriptors, with regional map-portal access. Public access is stated and a provider reuse document is linked, but its licence terms were not read; precise licence and file-use costs remain unknown. The metadata does not establish building footprints, condition, construction dates, occupancy, structural properties or a specific simulation use. Related PTP transport and ski-installation components describe different subjects of the same plan. No features, map or linked document body was obtained.
